title: Vitamin D Treatment to Patients Suffering From Chronic Pain and Vitamin D Hypovitaminosis
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to check whether vitamin D will lead to a decrease in pain intensity compare to placebo, in patients suffering from chronic pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* men and women over 18, who suffer from chronic pain and hypovitaminosis D

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients that are treated with vitamin D
